message: Root cause: after adding the Move menu, drag remained constrained to the tiny drag handle, so card/image dragging was rejected and felt broken. Fix: make the whole tile a drag source while exempting .move-menu controls. Verified in Chrome DevTools by dragging from page image to page 5: order changed, Apply/Undo enabled; Move menu click opens without dirtying order. Tests: organizer suite 42 passed; full suite 302 passed, 4 deselected.
